title: List sponsors
story: As a anonymoususer, I want to view a list of sponsors, so that I can thank all the awesome sponsors.
acceptance_criteria: I can thank all the awesome sponsors.
System displays list with all relevant items
Users can navigate through paginated results

title: Cancellation terms
story: As a trainee, I want to must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox, so that they can be accountable..

title: Add event to schedule
story: As a trainee, I want to add to "my schedule" if there is a schedule feature on the site, so that they can schedule their event experience.
acceptance_criteria: They can schedule their event experience.

title: Venue description
story: As a anonymoususer, I want to view venue details, so that I can get a sense of the location and see the events happening there.
acceptance_criteria: I can get a sense of the location and see the events happening there.

title: Process payment
story: As a authenticateduser, I want to Enter payment information and have my card charged for an individual sponsorship, so that I can pay for an individual sponsorship.
acceptance_criteria: I can pay for an individual sponsorship.
Transaction confirmation is sent to user
Failed transactions display appropriate error messages

title: Assign sponsors
story: As a sponsor, I want to link BADCamp attendees to my sponsorship page, so that I can show off our level of attendance.
acceptance_criteria: I can show off our level of attendance.

title: Tag posts
story: As a administrator, I want to tag my blog posts for consumption by Drupal Planet, so that they will be listed on the Drupal Planet blog.
acceptance_criteria: They will be listed on the drupal planet blog.

title: View events
story: As a attendee, I want to see what summits I'm signed up for, so that I can confirm my attendence and prevent myself from accidentally double-booking with a training or another summit.
acceptance_criteria: I can confirm my attendence and prevent myself from accidentally double-booking with a training or another summit.

title: Post job listing
story: As a sponsor, I want to post a job, so that I can hire top-tier Drupal talent.
acceptance_criteria: I can hire top-tier drupal talent.

title: Accept session
story: As a administrator, I want to mark a session as accepted, so that I can populate the schedule .

title: Speaker registration
story: As a anonymoususer, I want to register to speak at BADCamp, so that I submit a session.
